COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS ### 2.1 Button Component Requirements All variants: pill shape, flex layout (`display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;`), minimum touch target 44×44px, lowercase labels, transitions on all state changes. - **Variants:** `.btn-primary` (solid `--bg-inverse` fill with `--text-inverse` text — auto-inverts per theme), `.btn-gradient` (`--gradient-blaze` fill, white text, hero + featured-pricing CTA), `.btn-secondary` (transparent, 1.5px border, text `--text-primary`), `.btn-danger` (solid `--primary` fill, white text, warning icon — visually distinct in both themes), `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-icon` (44×44 circle for close/menu/copy/theme toggle). - **Hover:** brightness lift and/or `--shadow-md`; `cursor: pointer`. - **Focus:** distinct `:focus-visible` ring (2px `--primary` outline, 2px offset) for keyboard navigation. - **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`. - **Loading (`.is-loading`):** disables interaction, prevents double-clicks, renders a CSS spinner or rotating Material `progress` icon without changing button dimensions;
